compatibility: One framework + one matching-family striker + any one core. No fourth equipment part.
snapshot: Skill bonus and forge are frozen at craft creation; later respec cannot retroactively change an item.
strike_cap: Universal maximum 15 blows for every combination. Never stop at a limit-relative count: that would disclose the hidden limit. Excess blows continue scaling elemental leakage; durability floors at 5% of base before its hidden random roll.
cancel: Until the first blow, cancellation returns all components. After a blow, stopping finalizes the current item; no material refunds.
critical_note: 175% and 200% mean 1.75x and 2.00x total attack, not +175%/+200%.

forge_locations.mistvale: relic outside Mistvale city, unlocked through courier story
forge_locations.sands: secret Golden Expanse forge, revealed only after first completed Mistvale craft

mistvale_bonus: 1.10x final physical and elemental weapon attack; does not stack with sands forge bonus.
sands_bonus: Perfect curve is 1.25 + 0.75*(2**((L-2)/8)-1), reaching 2.00x. Under-struck attack uses 1.15x base-state output. Neither stacks with Mistvale; Sands is stronger at every limit.
formula_source: tools/build_crafting_catalog.py: stats() is the exact balance reference, not game runtime.

salvage.fusion_fee: 25% of that core appraisal, rounded half-up; restore the SAME core id.
salvage.degraded_stock: One degraded framework stock and one degraded striker stock; four same-material degraded pieces + 5 gold recover one original raw stock.
salvage.intact_disassembly: At a suitable workshop, consumes weapon and returns 1 core shard plus 2 degraded stocks. Never returns original parts.
salvage.cracked_repair: Cannot repair, stabilize, dismantle safely into original parts, or reveal remaining durability.
salvage.ordnance_recovery: Survive battle and recover salvage at impact/device site; no automatic remote salvage.
salvage.fusion_gate: Must previously discover the whole core; neither fusion nor salvage unlocks an undiscovered core.

anti_exploit.terminal: Remove weapon/ordnance from inventory before damage event; one unique detonation id prevents duplicate bursts.
anti_exploit.ordnance: Tessa: 1 full action + 14 MP. Tobin: 1 full action + 18 MP; device arms at end of his action, max 1 deployed. Proposed costs.
anti_exploit.payload: Use the same pre-defense terminal budget and radius as that cracked weapon. Remaining hidden durability never increases payload strength.
anti_exploit.self_feed: Firing a cracked cannon does not recursively consume loaded cracked ordnance. One payload item and one detonation event.
anti_exploit.staff: Every offensive weapon-channeling action consumes durability; healing, guard and non-weapon spells do not. Multi-hit actions pay once.
anti_exploit.hidden_life: On crack: hidden starting durability sampled uniformly from integer range shown in designer data. Each offensive action spends 1–3 hidden points uniformly. Item RNG state persists through save/load.
anti_exploit.reload: Outcome and RNG progression committed with item/action transaction; reloading cannot reroll a completed forge or hit.

ledger.acquired: On accepting the first courier mission.
ledger.ordinary_recipes: Knowledge aids experimentation; discovered parts may be combined before their recipe page is owned.
ledger.hidden_values: Component strike contributions only revealed by acquired pages; other hidden values never appear in ordinary equipment UI.
ledger.secret_reveal: First finalized Mistvale forge use after restoration triggers the book and new sand map once. Under-struck, Masterwork and cracked outcomes all qualify; preview/cancel does not.

purchased_equipment: Existing loot/shop items keep independent identities and benefits; do not automatically replace them with generated catalog recipes.
